frozen_verdict_rule: R = |Delta G_total| / bar_sum with the PRIMARY formula; bar_sum = bar(a0_c7:x0) + bar(a0_c7:n7_p0.25_e1.0) from phase_a_tables.json T1 (Addendum 44 ruling 6: the bar-sum is the operative test; sigma_Q provenance only). R < 1 -> SUB-RESOLUTION at SRP1: the estimated barrier-gap difference cannot by itself produce a determinate value difference, and the sub-resolution caveat applies at SRP1 as at 2x2. R >= 1 -> AT/ABOVE RESOLUTION at SRP1: the caveat does not suffice there and the gap difference is material to the SRP1 value. The upper-bound variant is reported beside R and does not change the verdict; if it crosses 1 while R < 1 that is reported as a qualification.
